text:
morgan: Quick UX check from a short playthrough of the routing editor sandbox. A few small things that block clarity — filing these before I forget. :coffee:

samir: thanks — can you bullet them so I can slot into sprint?

morgan: sure: 1) users miss the inline reorder affordance (drag handle is small + no keyboard hint). 2) sim output floods the right column on long runs. 3) validation tone is opaque.

tia: +1 on handle size. Suggest increasing hit target to 28px and add an inline label: 'Reorder rules' (visually hidden for SRs).

kelly: on copy: current: "Rule failed: ambiguous selector". Proposed: "Conflicting rule detected. Click to view the earlier rule that this one overlaps with." Keep it short and action-first.

rachel: keyboard flow thought: "Press Enter to pick up rule, then Up/Down to move; Enter to drop." Also ensure endpoint announces "Moved to position 3 of 8" (aria-live polite).

samir: implementable. We'll add an ARIA live region with role="status" for position updates. Avoid verbose updates on simulation refresh.

daniel: sim collapse idea: show a concise summary row in the pane header: "Matches: 18 • Conflicts: 2 • Samples: 6"; clicking expands detailed per-sample rows. Keeps default view scannable.

morgan: love that. Also want a dedicated 'Conflicts' pill that, when clicked, filters the rules list to only show items involved in conflicts. Helps triage quickly.

kelly: UX detail for expanded logs: no raw JSON. Use single-line items: "signup_flow — send-welcome (10) — conflict with block-spam" and a tiny sparkline for frequency.

designbot: Sandbox run @2151234567 snapshot:
```
summary: matched=10, conflicts=2, samples=4
examples: [signup_flow:7, api_ingest:2, cron_job:1]
```

rachel: small contrast nit on the collapse chevron; current fg/bg ~3.1:1. Need >=4.5:1 for body. I'll add an annotation in figma and propose a darker stroke.

tia: accessibility note: ensure keyboard-reorder-mode sets aria-grabbed=true on the active item and that screenreaders announce "Item moved" only once per move.

samir: also we should throttle sim updates when user is actively reordering to avoid janky experience. Maybe debounce 600ms.

daniel: animation idea for header chevron to indicate new conflicts: subtle pulse on the pill (prefers-reduced-motion respected).

morgan: action items: samir (keyboard + aria tweaks + debounce), daniel (header collapse + pill + animation), kelly (copy variants + screenreader strings), rachel (contrast a11y notes + figma annotations), tia (increase handle hit target + aria-grabbed guidance). I'll create tickets and link them to the policy-editor epic.

kelly: will post copy PR later today with both friendly and neutral tones + SR-only text.

samir: assigning to me for the sprint, I'll ping when ready for review.

morgan: thanks all. small improvements but should make reorder + simulation much less confusing. :tada:
